lanes.title: Allow an owner-approved admission basis for approved quote providers
lanes.description: Linear OVD-641 (owner decision 2026-10-06, companion of OVD-640). In supabase/migrations/20260817133902_add_quote_provider_admission_registry.sql the check constraint quote_provider_approved_permission_check lets a policy reach admission_state = 'approved' only when permission_basis is provider_terms_allow_automation or written_provider_authorization. Owner outcome: an owner-approved admission no longer needs a vendor-permission basis; the admission row still records who approved it, the evidence reference, envelope, session owner and expiry, and every other admission check stays exactly as strict. Preferred shape: ONE new additive migration (applied migrations are never edited) that adds an owner_approved value to the permission_basis vocabulary and allows it for approved; keep existing_controlled_beta_path restricted to Xometry controlled_beta_only as today. Dropping the approved-state permission check entirely is acceptable only if the reviewer prefers it; record the choice in the PR body. Update the resolver and any service-side validation that hard-codes the permission vocabulary, plus worker/src/providerUploadCapabilityTypes.ts and related tests if they mirror it. Update supabase/tests/quote_provider_admission_registry.sql, src/features/quotes/provider-admission-registry-migration.test.ts and scripts/verify-ovd418-production-postconditions.sql expectations (each only if it exists on main; say which do). Update the ARCHITECTURE.md provider admission registry bullets to describe the new rule so that the OVD-640 grep passes for that file: grep -rniE "written (automation|consent|permission|authoriz)|automation[- ]permission|prior (written )?consent|permission evidence|permission-incomplete|express written|missing permission" ARCHITECTURE.md returns nothing.
files: supabase/migrations/<new timestamp after every existing migration on main AND after 20261004130000>_ovd641_owner_approved_admission_basis.sql
worker/src/providerUploadCapabilityTypes.ts and its tests (only if they mirror the vocabulary)
the resolver / service-side validation that hard-codes the vocabulary (find it with git grep)
lanes.guidance: Base main (fetch first). Lockfiles follow main (/home/user/Overdrafter/node_modules symlinks; never remove them). Run ensure-docker.sh then `supabase status` from the worktree before DB work; every reset/test runs under `flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock sh -c '...'` and locked sections stay short; never supabase stop/start. Migration timestamp: later than every migration on main AND later than 20261004130000 (the release integration branch carries migrations up to that stamp; this one must sort after them when main is synced into it). Restate the function/constraint byte-for-byte apart from the guard change, with SECURITY settings, search_path and grants unchanged; the migration header states the rule change in words. Failing-first pgTAP: before the migration an approved policy with permission_basis owner_approved is rejected by the check constraint; after it, accepted; unknown basis values, existing_controlled_beta_path outside Xometry controlled beta, and incomplete admitted policies still fail; append-only history and new-revision rules unchanged (run the existing suite). Do not admit or enable any provider (no data changes, no allowlist change). Production apply is protected and NOT part of the PR: say so in the body. Sonar: byte-for-byte restates may trip duplication; one sonar.cpd.exclusions line for this migration is sanctioned if the duplication gate is red; grouped dispositions in the body. Open a DRAFT PR on main titled 'OVD-641: ...', body per the template, stating the merge target (main) and that the release packet gains one migration. Never write the release-parent identifiers listed in ENV.md (OVD-418/OVD-419 are among them: refer to the postconditions script by file name only); the issue identifiers you may write are OVD-641 and OVD-640; no Linear closing word before an issue id.
lanes.failure_first: pgTAP case red at main (owner_approved rejected for approved), green after the migration; the negative cases (unknown basis, misplaced existing_controlled_beta_path, incomplete policy) stay red; mutation on a scratch copy: removing the owner_approved branch from the guard makes the new case fail again.
lanes.verification: flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock sh -c 'supabase db reset --local && supabase test db --local supabase/tests/quote_provider_admission_registry.sql'; full `supabase test db --local` under the lock (capability_runtime_persistence_concurrency.sql is environment-only); npx vitest run src/features/quotes/provider-admission-registry-migration.test.ts and any worker tests touched; npm run verify:migration-lineage; npm run lint && npm run typecheck; flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify at the PR boundary. Hosted (result of record): test (database policies + Run tests), lint, typecheck, Sonar at the PR head.
